dct_creator_sm: Natural Resources Canada (Geological Survey of Canada, Natural Resources Canada).
dct_description_sm: These data have been applied to shore-zone description and classification for assessment of coastal stability and hazards. Additional applications may include coastal management and planning, oil-spill sensitivity mapping, physical access mapping, or qualitative coastal change analysis, among others.
dct_title_s: Canadian Coastal Information System (CIS) - Backshore, Beaufort Sea Coast 1984, 1999 and 2000
